info.title: DekernAI API (sandbox)
info.summary: Agentic payment controls: decision, orchestration and operations.
info.description: The public sandbox API. Test networks only: `sk_live_` keys are always refused. The AI proposes and the client's rules decide. Generated from the code (API-05); see the error-code reference for every `error.code`.

servers.description: Local development (make dev). The public sandbox address is published at launch.

tags.name: decisions
tags.description: Dry-run a payment against the active rules without creating it.

tags.name: deposit_intents
tags.description: Expected deposits and how incoming funds are matched to them.

tags.name: events
tags.description: Every webhook event, also available by polling.

tags.name: exceptions
tags.description: The exceptions queue: escalations, overdue cases and breaks, with their facts.

tags.name: kill_switch
tags.description: Hold every payout at once. Only the client's payments lead can release it.

tags.name: mandates
tags.description: What each AI agent may propose, within which limits.

tags.name: payment_intents
tags.description: Payouts: one ID for life, decided by the rules, sent exactly once.

tags.name: policy
tags.description: The client-owned rule set and its versions.

tags.name: reconciliation
tags.description: Reconciliation runs and the breaks they find.

tags.name: request_logs
tags.description: Your recent API requests, for debugging.

tags.name: webhook_endpoints
tags.description: Where events are sent, signed, with retries and resends.
